verdicts.typography: Flawless Swiss-style hierarchy. Mono uppercase labels are disciplined, heading scale is perfectly rhythmic, and the red accent on 'this?' and 'the integration' creates sharp focal points without breaking restraint. Line-height and tracking feel publication-grade.
verdicts.color: Nearly perfect minimalist discipline with one clear violation: the pale pink background fill on the final matrix column ('THIS SYSTEM') introduces a second accent value beyond the single restrained red. Everything else—pure black text, white surfaces, and the lone red mark—is impeccable.
verdicts.layout: Publication-grade grid alignment. The max-w container is consistent, whitespace rhythm is generous and deliberate, hairline borders are intact with no doubled lines, and the footer is correctly pinned to the document bottom in the long-scroll view.
verdicts.components: Excellent component architecture. The matrix table uses legible marks, the accordion list has clear affordances (chevrons, red dots), and the stat strip is clean. One nitpick: the sticky first column in the scrolled view truncates 'EARLY WARNING PROJECT' to 'ED'/'T', which harms legibility for a core data label.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless mobile and dark-mode execution. Mobile layout maintains perfect integrity at 390px with no overflow or clipped text. The wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling elegantly with a sticky first column that remains perfectly legible. Dark mode palette is consistent across all components with excellent contrast ratios.

color: Remove or replace the pale pink background fill on the 'THIS SYSTEM' matrix column; use a white background with a heavier left border or bold red header text instead to maintain strict single-accent discipline.
components: Increase the minimum width of sticky matrix columns or allow two-line wrapping for organization names so they don't truncate to illegible 2-3 character fragments when horizontally scrolled.
